title: GovernedBlackboardEntry
description: The Baltor GOVERNANCE wrapper around one BlackboardEntry: the seam where Teleon's working state meets Baltor's served-truth governance. It NEVER makes the entry truth (serves_truth is pinned const false); it records the governance verdict ABOUT the entry so Baltor can decide promotion separately. claim_status spans candidate | verified | conflicting | held_out | stale (a swarm entry is born candidate; it can be verified, found conflicting, held out, or go stale — none of those is auto-served). authority_rank is the numeric reconciliation weight; verification_status/held_out_reason/freshness_policy/temporal_validity carry the governance metadata; promotion_eligible is the explicit, auditable gate (a swarm conclusion is promotable only when Baltor's checks pass — verified + non-conflicting + fresh + sourced). receipt_refs[] and source_handles[] tie the verdict to worker receipts and upstream provenance; tenant_scope keeps governance tenant-isolated.

entry_id.description: the BlackboardEntry this governance verdict wraps

blackboard_id.description: the blackboard the wrapped entry belongs to

authority_rank.description: numeric authority weight used during reconciliation (higher wins conflicts); graph data, not a display label

claim_status.description: Baltor's governance status for the claim: born candidate; may become verified, conflicting, held_out, or stale — none is auto-served truth

verification_status.description: governance verification state/verdict for the claim (e.g. unverified | passed | failed | needs_review)

held_out_reason.description: if held out, why (minority finding, rejected candidate, unresolved conflict); empty when not held out — held_out != deleted

freshness_policy.description: the freshness/CDC policy governing how stale this claim may get before re-verification

temporal_validity.description: the temporal validity window for the claim (when it is/was true), e.g. an ISO interval or 'as_of' marker

tenant_scope.description: owning tenant; governance and lineage stay tenant-isolated and never become global

promotion_eligible.description: explicit, auditable gate: true ONLY when Baltor's checks pass (verified + non-conflicting + fresh + sourced); candidate != active, benchmark != promotion

receipt_refs.description: BlackboardWorkerReceipt ids (and other receipt refs) backing this verdict — provenance for the governance decision

source_handles.description: upstream provenance handles (ctx:// or doc#section) for the wrapped claim — a governed claim is never sourceless

serves_truth.description: ALWAYS false — wrapping for governance never itself makes the entry served truth; serving is a separate gated step keyed off promotion_eligible
